title: Employee Privacy Request Letter Template - Workplace Surveillance
metaDescription: Professional letter template to request information about workplace surveillance and monitoring policies. Protect your employee privacy rights.
description: A formal letter template to help employees request transparency about workplace surveillance practices, monitoring policies, and privacy protections from their employer. Includes guidance on your rights and professional communication strategies.

sections.heading: Subject and Opening
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Information Regarding Workplace Monitoring and Privacy Policies

Dear [Manager/HR Director Name],

I am writing to formally request information about our company's workplace surveillance and employee monitoring practices. As an employee, I believe it is important to understand how my privacy and personal information are protected in the workplace.

sections.heading: Information Request
sections.content:
I would appreciate receiving detailed information about the following aspects of our workplace monitoring policies:

• What types of employee monitoring and surveillance are currently in use (computer activity, email, internet usage, phone calls, video surveillance, etc.)
• The specific purposes for which monitoring data is collected
• How long monitoring data is retained and stored
• Who has access to monitoring data and under what circumstances
• Whether employees are notified when monitoring occurs
• What privacy protections are in place for employee personal information
• The company's policy regarding personal use of work devices and internet
• Any third-party vendors involved in monitoring or data processing

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made in accordance with my rights as an employee to understand workplace policies that affect my privacy. I would appreciate receiving this information within [timeframe] business days, as outlined in our employee handbook or as reasonable under company policy.

I understand that workplace monitoring may be necessary for legitimate business purposes, and I simply wish to be fully informed about these practices to ensure I can comply with all policies appropriately.

sections.heading: Professional Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your time and attention to this matter. I look forward to receiving the requested information and am happy to discuss this further if needed. Please let me know if you require any clarification regarding this request.

I can be reached at [your email] or [your phone number] if you have any questions.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Job Title]
[Employee ID (if applicable)]
